newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street seen opening flat to lower, eyes data.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street seen opening flat to lower, eyes data.

text.p: Wall Street stocks are expected to open flat to lower on Tuesday with direction coming from inflation data and reaction to Intel's earnings.
Analysts said markets would be taking their cue in part from the Labor Department's March consumer price index (CPI) figures, due out at 1230 GMT.
Economists expect a 0.2 percent rise overall and a 0.3 percent upswing excluding volatile food and energy prices.
A strong CPI could spur the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates next month.
